include: Enumerate all pinned blackbox/ean13-<number> directories. Record all EAN13BlackBox<number>TestCase.java definitions and authoritative EAN_13 constructor format; retain any additional ean13 directory as a separately flagged folder-inferred suite, rather than silently omitting it.
Include every direct child raster image in those directories with an exact companion .txt containing exactly 13 ASCII digits, no trimming, and a valid EAN13 check digit.
Use upstream image extensions accepted by AbstractBlackBoxTestCase (read source before enumerating images); keep exclusions in the manifest.
Freeze complete eligible case list, companion truth, source hashes, licensing, and deterministic derived-frame conversion before any new corpus decoding.
ambiguity: A single companion label does not prove one physical code. Retain such photos, flag source labels as a single intended target only, and report exact/wrong/miss relative to that label without population accuracy claims. Adjacent supplement/other code ambiguity remains explicit.
pipelines: original pixels flattened white to sRGB
640x480 fit-inside no-upscale centered limited-luma then expanded RGB; white alpha composite, lanczos3 only if needed, paddingY200
readerProfiles: Local zxing-wasm3.1.5 raw reader, formatsEAN13, tryHarderfalse/true, minLineCount2/3/4, tryRotate=true, tryDownscale=true, tryInvert=false, maxNumberOfSymbols255, LocalAverage, HRI, eanAddOnIgnore, returnErrorsfalse.
classification: Exact means at least one text equal to truth and no differing payload; wrong means at least one differing returned payload (including mixed exact+wrong); miss means no returned symbol. Record exactPresent and every text/lineCount separately.
limits: Diagnostic ZXing-derived blackbox corpus; related to reader training/development, not independent, phone or Scandit test. Prior knowledge of ean13-2/07 disclosed; all eligible suite cases included mechanically. No SDK/API/default modifications.
